CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click

    Dim stDocName As String
    Dim bSintetico As Boolean
    
    bSintetico = Me!Sintetico
    
    If (NomeFinanceiraPadrao <> "N/A" And (Not (bSintetico))) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa"
    If (NomeFinanceiraPadrao = "N/A" And (Not (bSintetico))) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa Sem Financeira"
    
    If (NomeFinanceiraPadrao <> "N/A" And (bSintetico)) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa Sintetico"
    If (NomeFinanceiraPadrao = "N/A" And (bSintetico)) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa Sem Financeira Sintetico"
    
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaZerar", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaArquivoMorto", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaArquivoAtual", acViewNormal, acEdit
    
    DoCmd.OpenReport stDocName, acPreview

Exit_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click:
    MsgBox Err.Description
    Resume Exit_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click
    
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Activate()
    DTFinal = Date
    Do While Day(DTFinal) <= 31
        DTFinal = DTFinal + 1
       If Month(DTFinal) <> Month(Date) Then
            DTFinal = DTFinal - 1
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop
    DTInicial = DateSerial(Year(Date), Month(Date), ((Day(Date)) - (Day(Date)) + 1))
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "Plano2 Marcar Todos", acNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdRefresh
End Sub
